facts.business: Onesource Industries and Ventures Limited operates in the agriculture and trading sector, dealing in key agricultural commodities such as rice, pulses, and allied products.
facts.related_party_note: The Company has entered into business advance transactions with Greater-India Exports Private Limited and Sadbhav Minerals Private Limited (private companies in which Directors/Promoters/their relatives are interested directly or indirectly) at arm's length basis. Board approved limits on 30th May 2025. No non-arm's length transactions.
